newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Strike at Brazil's Santos affecting mainly imports.
newsitem.headline: Strike at Brazil's Santos affecting mainly imports.

text.p: A strike by warehouse workers at Brazil's key port of Santos was affecting 90 percent of imports as well as a smaller percentage of exports, said the secretary of the Administrative Portworkers' Union.
"The strike is principally affecting imports," said Gerson da Quinta. "It is affecting 90 percent of imports and to some degree, it is affecting exports although the impact is much lower."
A spokeswoman for the port earlier said exports were not affected by the strike. The union official was unable to give an estimate of what percentage of exports were affected.
Some 140 workers are involved in the strike, which began at 0700 local/1000 GMT and was due to continue indefinitely.
The port authority and unions were scheduled to hold a round-table meeting at 1500 local/1800 GMT at the local labour tribunal in Sao Paulo, da Quinta said.
Previous strikes at the port have seriously affected shipments of sugar, soybeans, orange juice and other commodities.
